name: Uju's Trio: Picnic Adventure
source:
The game tells the mysterious story of curious Uju, Malti with a feisty side, and Shawn, who loves to eat, on a picnic.

What will happen to three cute puppies?

[From [url=https://pesky-panthera.itch.io/uju-picnic-adventure]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
好奇心旺盛的宇宙、有些潑辣的馬爾蒂，還有愛吃東西的肖恩一起去野餐，遊戲講述的就是它們在途中經歷的神秘故事。

三隻可愛的小狗會遇上什麼事呢？

［摘自[url=https://pesky-panthera.itch.io/uju-picnic-adventure]itch.io[/url]］
